about.title: Together, we create the digital
paragraphs: BRB-TECH develops technological solutions for financial institutions, banks, government organizations, and businesses that simplify processes, improve efficiency, and create new opportunities.

BRB-TECH is a team of professionals united by a common goal: to make technology accessible, efficient, and results-driven for everyone. We take responsibility for the entire cycle — from research and design to implementation and ongoing support.

We create technologies that become part of everyday life — simplifying processes, unlocking new opportunities, and helping organizations move forward. Our approach combines technological expertise, a people-centered focus, and a commitment to measurable results.

education.title: Education
education.subtitle: We teach the expertise we ourselves have implemented.
paragraphs: BRB-TECH Academy is our company’s educational division. What sets us apart is simple: our instructors are the company’s own engineers and product managers, and the course material consists of real-world tasks drawn from live projects. Students don’t study abstract examples; instead, they learn how actual banking systems are built.
We tailor corporate programs to the specific needs of banks, companies, and government organizations, while also training professionals looking to enter the fields of IT and AI through open courses.

ai.title: Artificial intelligences
ai.subtitle: Artificial intelligence — in your data, within your perimeter.
paragraphs: BRB-TECH AI-Lab is integrating artificial intelligence into banking products, including voice agents, financial diagnostics, voice-based payments, and conversation analysis. All solutions operate on-premise—using our own GPU infrastructure and local models—ensuring that customer data never leaves the internal environment for external clouds.

Our core strength is the Uzbek language. We possess proprietary speech recognition (STT) and synthesis (TTS) models, language models supporting both Uzbek and Russian, and a RAG architecture proven in banking applications. We are now deploying this infrastructure for other organizations as well.

paragraphs: Our team of 74 specialists—spanning design, product, analytics, backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and Data & AI—has built banking systems serving millions of users. b2b.title: B2B Ecosystem
b2b.subtitle: Digital ecosystem for company management
paragraphs: In many companies, customer data resides in one system, employee data in another, tasks are handled via messaging apps, and documents are exchanged via email. We consolidate all of this into a single ecosystem—comprising CRM, HRM, task management, and electronic document workflows—featuring a shared database, unified login, and role-based access.

The modules operate both independently and together: you can start with one and add the others without migrating data. We deploy them on-premise or in the cloud and customize them to fit the client's processes.

bank.title: Bank management and control systems
bank.subtitle: Systems that manage the bank from within
paragraphs: The customer-facing application is merely the tip of the iceberg. Beneath it lie the internal systems that manage the customer base, sales processes, segmentation, and credit risks. BRB-TECH has built this layer for the bank and continues to support its daily operations: managers work with a unified customer profile, management makes decisions based on real-time data, and the credit portfolio is monitored automatically.
We implement these systems for other banks and financial institutions by integrating them with their core banking systems and data warehouses.
